events.title: House floor action on H.R. 7567
events.official_text: DEBATE - Pursuant to the provisions of H. Res. 1224, the Committee of the Whole proceeded with 10 minutes of debate on the Self amendment No. 47.

events.title: House floor action on H.R. 7567
events.official_text: An amendment, offered by Mr. Self, numbered 47 printed in Part B of House Report 119-628 to add "soda" to the definition of ineligible items and defines soda as a carbonated beverage containing more than 1 gram of added sugar, artificial sweetener, or flavoring per serving.
